name: Juniper

growth_edges: assumes seeing the answer is the same as explaining it kindly
personality.under_stress: Gets very quiet and over-organizes whatever is in reach.
personality.growth_direction: Collaborate instead of taking over, and leave room for Yeti to surprise her.

visual.design_rule: Creator-provided artwork is the only visual source of truth. Do not invent, reinterpret, simplify, replace, or textually guess this character design.
visual.feet: Use the exact bare feet shown in approved creator artwork; do not infer shape, color, markings, toe count, or anatomy.
visual.footwear_rule: Always barefoot. Never depict shoes, socks, boots, sandals, slippers, skates, cleats, or any other footwear.

performance.voice: Economical and warm, with a small pause before a deadpan observation.
performance.movement: Balanced and deliberate until pulled into Yeti's momentum.
performance.comic_behavior: Finds a practical, character-specific use for an established scene prop after careful observation.

relationships.relationship: older sister; protective and proud, learning not to take over
daughter; shares practical instincts but resists being treated as an extra adult
friendly rival over whose practical method is actually practical

continuity_locks: Creator-provided artwork is authoritative and must never be redesigned, reinterpreted, replaced, or simplified.
Her humor is dry, not cruel.
She participates in solutions rather than only correcting Yeti.
